attempted_claim: Is there a unit-area flat surface (X,omega) of genus g>1 with minimal vertical flow such that limsup_{t->infinity} (-log delta_t(omega))/(log t) < 1 and the vertical flow on (X,omega) is not uniquely ergodic, where delta_t(omega) is the flat systole of the Teichmuller geodesic g_t omega?
decisive_failure: No construction or gap theorem was proved; the slit-family power-law computations are heuristic exponent models, not rigorous systole bounds; minimality and non-unique ergodicity were never jointly certified for any candidate with limsup below 1, so the Chaika-Trevino open question remains fully open.
